name: Medicine and Health
fwnote: NHES codes read standard.grade-span.indicator (1.2.1 = Standard 1, by grade 2, indicator 1); Illinois health is cited at the goal level only (Goal 22, Goal 23), because the goal is what we can state with certainty; history-of-medicine units cite C3 history and NGSS where they honestly fit. Alignment is the course author's judgment, not a certification.
